en.title: BOX: An AI-Assisted Visual Story
en.subtitle: Shaped generated footage into a coherent, playable short film.
en.background: A personal short film built around a box that travels through time and space. Multiple generated clips contained repeated shots, inconsistent character versions and mismatched audio; the narrative order and footage needed careful selection.
en.role: Set the creative brief and reviewed the content, including character order, emotional contrast, selected shots and revision criteria.
work: Defined the story sequence—opening the box, travelling, character changes and closing the box—and supplied five generated video files.
Reviewed repeated shots, transitions and audio-visual alignment; requested removal of the expanding-box screen transition and provided feedback through multiple revisions.
Chose “We shall see.” for the ending and reviewed the final deliverable.
en.collaboration: AI assisted with storyboard and prompt organisation, footage selection, editing, frame interpolation and file checks.
en.result: Selected footage from two of five supplied files to produce a four-part 720p film, removing repeated shots and replacing the closing line.
outcomes: Delivered one 15.52-second, 1280 × 720 short film playable on this site.
Organised the story into four parts with short crossfades between shots.
Removed the old ending audio and added the English line “We shall see.”
en.value: Shows how I translate a creative brief into a reviewable deliverable and refine it through feedback.
en.boundary: A personal creative exercise. The source visuals were AI-generated; the 48 fps export uses frame interpolation.
en.dataNote: Duration and frame rate are from the final file; the four narrative parts are counted from the edit.

pga.kind: 本科毕设 · 半导体与电路
pga.title: 8档可编程增益放大器设计
pga.status: 设计与仿真材料已形成
pga.subtitle: 围绕模拟前端的输入适配需求，把增益控制落到电路、仿真与版图。
pga.background: 固定增益放大器难以适配不同幅度的输入信号。本科毕设采用开关电阻反馈网络，通过数字控制切换电阻通路，调节模拟信号增益。
pga.role: 在本科毕设中完成电路原理分析、仿真整理与版图实现，并解释增益控制结果。
work: 围绕运算放大器、开关电阻网络和CMOS开关，整理8档增益调节结构。
进行DC、AC和瞬态分析，对照各档位增益、频率响应及输入输出波形。
完成版图布局布线，检查LVS连通性与DRC规则结果，整理论文和答辩材料。
pga.collaboration: 在本科毕业设计指导下完成，工具包括Cadence Virtuoso与Spectre。
pga.result: 形成原理图、3类仿真和实际版图；8档AC仿真增益约为0至23.47dB，LVS比较结果为CORRECT。
outcomes: 8档AC仿真覆盖约−0.01085至23.469dB；最高档线性增益约14.909倍。
保留DC、AC和瞬态分析材料，以及实际布局布线图。
LVS比较显示连通性一致；DRC金属密度与填充问题仍待完善。
pga.value: 体现理解技术指标、整理验证结果并将复杂电路方案讲清楚的能力。
pga.boundary: 数值均为仿真结果；尚有DRC密度填充问题，未作为流片或芯片实测成果。

en.title: 8-Step Programmable Gain Amplifier Design
en.subtitle: Translated an analogue front-end gain-control requirement into a circuit, simulations and layout.
en.background: A fixed-gain amplifier is less adaptable to inputs with different amplitudes. The undergraduate project used a digitally controlled switched-resistor feedback network to adjust analogue signal gain.
en.role: Analysed the circuit, organised simulation results, produced the layout and explained the gain-control results as part of my undergraduate thesis.
work: Developed the eight-step gain-control structure around an operational amplifier, switched-resistor network and CMOS switches.
Performed DC, AC and transient analyses, reviewing gain levels, frequency responses and input/output waveforms.
Produced the physical layout, examined LVS connectivity and DRC results, and prepared thesis and presentation materials.
en.collaboration: Completed under undergraduate thesis supervision using Cadence Virtuoso and Spectre.
en.result: Produced a schematic, three types of simulation and a physical layout. Simulated AC gain ranges from approximately 0 to 23.47 dB across eight settings; the LVS comparison reports CORRECT.
outcomes: Eight simulated AC settings range from approximately −0.01085 to 23.469 dB; the maximum linear gain is approximately 14.909×.
Retained DC, AC and transient analysis materials and the physical layout.
LVS comparison reports matching connectivity; DRC metal-density and fill issues still require work.
en.value: Demonstrates interpreting technical metrics, documenting verification and explaining a circuit design clearly.
en.boundary: All figures are simulated. DRC density and fill issues remain; this is not a fabricated chip or a measured silicon result.
en.dataNote: The eight settings, process node and AC values come from the thesis presentation; 23.47 dB is rounded from 23.469 dB.

Thesis presentation, page 13: simulated AC response at the highest setting
